spec.command: bash scripts/run_exp16_training.sh (vanilla GPU0, 9-class GPU1; MLM pending GPU0 after vanilla)
spec.data_path: data/mixed_llm/ (350 train / 74 val / 76 test, 250 Qwen + 250 Llama)

experiment_data.hypothesis: Training on mixed Qwen+Llama conversations (250+250) eliminates single-LLM confound: the evidence hierarchy (9-class >> MLM >> vanilla) holds on mixed data, and cross-LLM false positive rate drops vs single-source training, proving DAPT generalizes across LLM distributions
